title: Book a Savings Finder appointment
summary: Book a free 45-minute appointment with a Savings Finder specialist to help find and apply for rebates, vouchers, and discounts.
intro: You can book a free 45-minute appointment with a Savings Finder specialist. They'll help you to find and apply for rebates, vouchers and discounts that you may be eligible for.

how_to_steps.text: Select one of the Savings Finder options from the list:
Choose a date and time for your appointment.

more_info.text: At the appointment, the specialist may need to ask personal questions about your situation. This may include questions about your health, household assets and income.
You can choose how much information you'd like to share. You can opt-out of answering a question or stop the appointment at any time.
Our privacy statement explains how we manage your personal information.
